SELECT 
  d.calendar_date,
  d.day_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.web_order_id) AS order_count
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order f ON DATE(f.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date = '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY d.calendar_date, d.day_name

SELECT 
  status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS total_web_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01'

SELECT 
  DATE(order_ts_utc) AS order_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) >= '2025-11-28' AND DATE(order_ts_utc) <= '2025-12-03'
GROUP BY DATE(order_ts_utc)
ORDER BY order_date

SELECT 
  COUNT(web_order_id) AS total_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_order_ids
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01'
